# vcell-chombo builds with GCC rather than the Clang/libc++ toolchain the other
# VCell solver repos use.  Chombo is half Fortran, and gfortran's runtime is
# built against libstdc++ -- mixing it with libc++ in one link is not supported.
[settings]
arch=x86_64
build_type=Release
compiler=gcc
compiler.version=13
compiler.libcxx=libstdc++11
compiler.cppstd=20
os=Linux

[conf]
# Required: conanfile.py's layout() only flattens the tree to build/generators
# when this is set.  Without it, cmake_layout() emits build/Release/generators.
tools.cmake.cmaketoolchain:generator=Ninja

[options]
fPIC=True
shared=False
